item.description: An Oregon couple in their 70s have been awarded more than $8 million after a jury found companies liable for unlawfully foreclosing on their home while they were still living in it. The Salem couple had also been denied more than $175,000 left over from the foreclosure sale, which took place in 2022. The jury found that the companies had carried out unlawful trade practices and financially abused the elderly homeowners. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Kublai Khan’s warship sank in 1281; 745 years later, dice reveal how its crew spent breaks
item.description: Archaeologists recently found gaming pieces and dice from a Mongol invasion shipwreck near Takashima Island. Other artefacts discovered nearby include food containers and tools indicative of daily life aboard the ship. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Ecuador: ¿qué han cambiado 1.000 días de estado de excepción?
item.description: Ecuador cumple 1.000 días bajo estados de excepción desde enero de 2024, una estrategia que ha normalizado la presencia militar en las calles. Las cifras oficiales registraron menos homicidios en 2024, pero la violencia repuntó en 2025 hasta un récord histórico. En 2026, pese a un nuevo descenso, los asesinatos siguen superando los 20 diarios. Desde Guayaquil, analizamos qué ha cambiado en la seguridad del país, el impacto de la militarización y las consecuencias de prolongar las medidas extraordinarias durante casi tres años. Reportaje de Carolina Mella para France 24. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
